name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the oldest merged PR with known issues. It tests the tool’s accuracy without altering outcomes, proving its reliability before we risk live reviews. The trade-off is delayed feedback on fresh issues, but we avoid breaking existing processes. Once validated, we’ll run PR-Agent on open PRs with known issues for 48 hours to catch edge cases. This proves the tool’s value before we pitch it as a permanent solution.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on old PRs tests past behavior, not current routing or prompt drift—so it proves nothing about today’s failures. Instead, run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the *newest* open PR with a known issue; that exposes fresh routing and prompt gaps before we risk live reviews. Settle it by comparing its output to a manual review within 24 hours—if it misses the same issue, the tool’s unreliable; if it catches it, we proceed.
